$comment: Telegram news-source registry for the breaking-news listener. Categories are markets|macro|trump|geopolitics|traders|crypto|india. The listener subscribes to each enabled channel and routes its messages into the matching category topic. Set enabled:false to mute a source without deleting it. Per-source slug is the public Telegram @handle WITHOUT the leading @. Broad-macro breaking keywords live in services/alerts/macroBreakingGate.js, NOT here — this file only declares which channels to listen to.
$verification: NEVER add a slug without running: curl -s -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://t.me/s/<slug> | grep -c tgme_widget_message_wrap. A count>0 proves the preview renders — it does NOT prove the handle is who you think. Verified squats that PASS the wrap check: 'zerodha' (1.55M subs, actually a binary-options scam called 'Quotex Trading'), 'etmarkets' (Ethiopian marketplace), 'Faytuks' (Persian channel). Always read the og:title and the bio before enabling. See test/newsSourcesRegistry.test.mjs, which fails the build if a known squat appears here.
